components.name: Action List_Item
components.status: **Ready** in `Platform`, `Product` and `Studio` on every surface; **Loyalty** on Canvas, `Low_Contrast/Surface_2` and `Surface_3` only; **Lux** blocked. See Accessibility

components.name: Bottom Navigation
components.status: Ready in all five modes for labels, icons and all five brands. The icon is optional (`Has Icon`); the belt hugs its content, so it is 57 high with icons and 48 without. The selected segment carries a `Brand` axis, which exists in Platform and Product only. **Do not put a timer badge on a selected segment in Loyalty or Studio** — it is one token for both selections and disappears on the selected fill there. Lux is the only mode that draws the shadow and the hairline; Loyalty and Studio select with the selection-control colour instead of a neutral surface. The keyboard focus ring misses 3:1 in Loyalty and Studio and is invisible on a focused selected segment there; the timer badge misses it on an unselected segment in Loyalty. Touch-only builds are unaffected by the focus ring. The belt must sit over the canvas, `Low_Contrast/Surface_2` or `Surface_3` — **not over `Surface_1`**. See **Where it can ship**.

components.status: Ready in all five modes for the day letters. The keyboard focus ring inherits the system-wide `Stroke/Focus/Default` failure in the dark themes.
